summary: The caster and up to five willing players in Touch lose States and Ongoing Effects and become Insubstantial in place, safe from most Forced Movement.

effects.subject: group
effects.note: Caster and up to five willing players within Touch range: all States and Ongoing Effects removed, then they become Insubstantial. Caster plus up to five willing players (max_targets counts the other players).

effects.subject: group
effects.note: Any abilities, on players (and their carried equipment) made Insubstantial by the same casting, as though they were not Insubstantial. Caster plus up to five willing players (max_targets counts the other players).

requirements.note: The other players must be willing.

restrictions.note: Caster plus up to five willing players within Touch range of the caster.

termination.note: Each target may end this Insubstantial State with the exit incantation for Insubstantial.
If the caster exits with the incantation, it ends for all targets.
When a target's Insubstantial State ends, the Ongoing Effects of Circle of Protection no longer apply to them.

references.name: Banish
references.note: Banish still affects the targets (the exception to Forced Movement immunity).

references.name: forced-movement
references.note: Targets are unaffected by Forced Movement effects other than Banish.

clarifications.text: A player who is prevented from becoming Insubstantial is unaffected by Circle of Protection entirely.

open_questions: E1 removes all States and Ongoing Effects before applying Insubstantial; whether Enchantments count as Ongoing Effects here is not stated.
N1 implies a player prevented from Insubstantial also keeps their States/Ongoing Effects (unaffected entirely); encoded as a clarification only.
